name: framecheck
does: The frame check: a throwaway game on the bench's seed and start driven through fixed scenes (the decks, a ground flight, a wave fight, the treehouse) at a fixed 1/60 s, then a sail in real time (the map table's sea chart, its flight to raven, the dive, the wake-up and the take-off from the treehouse), every frame drawn and timed on this machine's real renderer (frame, CPU and GPU ms as median, p95 and worst; draw calls, triangles, the quality rung, the GPU's name), shown with a Copy button; quick: half a second a scene; a scene's id after a comma (decks, ground-flight, wave-fight, treehouse, sail) runs only the scenes named. Her settings are read, nothing of hers is written. The pause page's Frame check button opens it in a frame over the paused game.
decision: Ed, 2026-11-15: "And have 8 be a button on the right side pause menu" (8, the coordinator's: a frame-time check he can run on his own machine).
